sizeGuide.title: Size Guide
sizeGuide.note: Measurements are approximate and may vary depending on the product.
sizeGuide.chestText: Measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape measure parallel to the ground.
sizeGuide.lengthText: Measure from the highest point of your shoulder down to your desired hem length.
sizeGuide.waistText: Measure around your natural waistline, typically where your pants sit.
sizeGuide.oversizedText: Our signature oversized fit is designed to be loose and comfortable. If you prefer a more relaxed look, we recommend sizing up.
sizeGuide.regularText: Our regular fit offers a comfortable, standard fit. True to size for most body types.
sizeGuide.widelegText: Our wide-leg sweatpants feature a relaxed, comfortable fit with extra room in the thighs and legs.

returns.title: Exchange & Returns
returns.intro: Changed your mind or picked the wrong size? No worries — exchanging or returning your order is simple.
returns.windowText: You can request an exchange or return within 14 days of receiving your order.
conditions: Items must be unworn, unwashed, and in their original condition
All tags must still be attached
Items must be in their original packaging
Contact us first before sending anything back
steps: Contact us through the Contact page or WhatsApp with your order number
Our team confirms your request within 24 hours
Hand the items to the courier at your door — no need to visit anyone
returns.shippingText: Exchanges for a different size are delivered free of charge. For returns and other exchanges, the delivery fee is deducted from your refund.
returns.defectiveText: Received a damaged item or the wrong size/color? We will exchange it immediately and cover all delivery costs — just send us a photo within 48 hours.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers to the most common questions.
questions: How do I place an order?
What payment methods do you accept?
How do I choose the right size?
Can I exchange or return an item?
How can I track my order?
answers: Browse the shop, choose your size and color, add items to your cart, then check out as a guest — no account needed. You will pay in cash when you receive your order.
Cash on Delivery only. You pay in cash when the courier hands you your order.
Orders are usually delivered within 2–5 business days depending on your city. Our customer service team calls to confirm every order within 24 hours.
Delivery is currently free on all orders across Egypt.
Check the size guide and the weight recommendation shown on each product page. If you are between two sizes and want an oversized fit, we recommend the larger one.
Yes — within 14 days, as long as items are unworn with tags attached. See our Exchange & Returns page for details.
Use the Track Your Order page with your order number and the phone number you used at checkout.
Through the Contact page, or message us directly on WhatsApp using the green button at the bottom of the screen.
